description: This file defines an asynchronous bot for a voice assistant application. It sets up speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), language model (LLM) interactions, and pipeline management for handling client connections. It includes configuration for various transport methods, initializes services for speech processing and LLM, and manages client connection events.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Class representing the context for the language model interaction, including message history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Class managing the pairing of user and assistant aggregators within the LLM context.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters configuring the user-side LLM aggregation, including turn strategies.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Class representing the data processing pipeline composed of multiple stages.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Class defining a specific task with a given pipeline and parameters, including idle timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for executing and managing the pipeline's runtime.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class providing the base methods and properties for transport mechanisms.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up services, defines the processing pipeline, and handles client connection events to run the voice assistant bot.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry function that initializes the transport and starts the bot.
